en.bdb: Mingling of the light of Guru Arjan Dev with the eternal light

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਹਿਦੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੀਨ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਹੇਤੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: rahidhe gur dhareeaau vich meen kuleen het nirabaanee|

en.bdb: Liberating the soul from the body, Guru (Arjan Dev) stabilized himself in the water of river as the fish remains in water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਜੋਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: dharasan dhekh pata(n)g jiau jotee a(n)dhar jot samaanee|

en.bdb: As the moth rows itself into the flame, his light mingled with light of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਭੀੜ ਪਈ ਚਿਤਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਆਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv mirag jiau bheeR piee chit avar na aanee|

en.bdb: Caring of for life, as the deer keeps its consciousness concentrated when in peril, the Guru also, when undergoing suffering kept none else except the Lord in is' consciousness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਵਰ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval mil bhavar jiau sukh sa(n)paT vich rain vihaanee|

en.bdb: As the black bee remains enrapt in the petals of flower • enjoy fragrance, the Guru also spent night of suffering by keeping joyfully s concentration on the feet of Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਬਾਬੀਹੇ ਜਿਉ ਆਖ ਵਖਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes na visarai baabeehe jiau aakh vakhaanee|

en.bdb: The Guru like a rainbird spoke to his disciples that the teachings of the Guru should not be forgotten.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras sahaj samaadh saadh sa(n)g jaanee|

en.bdb: The pleasure it of the Gurmukh (Guru Arjan Dev) is the delight of love and he accepts the holy congregation as the natural state of meditation.
I am sacrifice unto Guru Arjan Dev.
